notes: all 5 crops seen, both panels each; only perforations and faint punch shadows, no writing

crop 1 blank (damp stain only); crop 2 pencil '1939', which is the roll's catalogue number, matching the printed leader label in crop 4 (WELTE-MIGNON No. 1939, I. Sonata Op. 74 B flat 2nd movement, A. Glazounow); crop 3 carries a second four-figure pencil group in the same hand, first figure a 4, then 5 or 3, then 2, then 2 or 3 - possibly a punch date (4.5.22 / 4.5.23 / 4.3.23) but the figures are not plain enough to settle, so no date recorded

inscription: ...e Act, Variation III / A. Glazounow / [facsimile signature Glazounow] / Jan. 1910.
notes: crop 1 only perforations; crop 2 is the green cloth leader with the printed Welte label, partly cut off at the left - 'Jan. 1910' there is printed on the label, a recording/issue date, not a workshop punch inscription, so no punch date recorded; crop 3 is the join of cloth leader and red paper, blank. No handwriting anywhere in the three crops

ink, one line, read from the lower (180-degree) panel; the day's second figure and the month are the same glyph, a slanted 4 with a triangular counter and a crossing stem, and the year's 0 is a narrow closed oval. In the roll number the first figure has a closed upper loop crossing at the waist over an unclosed lower bowl, so 8 rather than 3, though 3 cannot be ruled out. The three dotted initials after the date and the 'II.' written beneath them are clear as marks but I cannot make out the letters. Crop 2 carries only a smudge.

pencil roll number only, no date on any crop; the figures are clipped by the crop edge in regions 1 and 2, and both read as the same four-digit number. Region 3 is the leader with the printed label '·WELTE-MIGNON· No. 1263 / Minuett / G major / Played by Paderewski'. Region 4 is a smudge, not writing.

ink, upper panel upright; the year figures are two 1s formed exactly like the '1.' of the day, and quite unlike the open-top 4s of the roll number 1445; second name written below the first, read as Wißler - possibly the hand recorded elsewhere in the corpus as Wössler

fine pencil, lower panel upright; both year figures have the same hooked lead-in and downstroke as the day's '1' and the month's '1', with no crossbar, so the year is 11 and not 14; no puncher's name in the crop
ink, upper panel upright; same two hands and the same layout as dq276yn8963 (roll 1445), the second name written below the first

inscription: WELTE-MIGNON / 1968 / GRAND VALSE de CONCERT / OP. 41. / GLAZOUNOW. / Played by M. KIMMONTT.
notes: crop 1 perforations only (plus a small patch over the paper), crop 2 blank paper edge, crop 3 the leader with the printed Welte label; the number 1968 is printed on the label, not written by the workshop, and the label carries no date. No handwriting in any of the three crops
stamped in type, not written, lower panel upright; six figures without separators, read as ddmmyy on the pattern of 311022 = 31.10.1922 given in the instructions
pencil, lower panel upright; six figures without separators, ddmmyy; no roll number or name in the crop

crop 1, lower panel upright; ink, one line, no name. Number 2000 with a full stop, then the date with its own stops. The month is a closed loop carrying a descender below the line, a 9 and not the plain oval the three 0s of 2000 and 30 show. Year 13.

crop 1, lower panel upright; pencil, one line, no name. Six figures in two groups, 11 and 1019: three 1s sharing the same flag, a narrow closed 0, and a 9 with a round head and a descender below the line. Read as 11.10.19.

inscription: [crop 2, pencil:] 2068 ; [crop 1, stamped:] 26525[?] ; [crop 4, printed label:] ·WELTE-MIGNON· / No. 2068 / Poême / Op. 32, No. 1 / A. Scriabine / Played by A. Scriabine ; [printed slip:] Das Recht der Vervielfältigung ist uns von den Künstlern ausdrücklich übertragen, eine anderweitige Vervielfältigung ist untersagt und wird nach den gesetzl. Bestimmungen verfolgt. M. WELTE & SÖHNE G.m.b.H. Freiburg i. B.
notes: the only workshop hand is the pencil 2068 in crop 2, which matches the No. 2068 on the printed label in crop 4; crop 3 holds only perforations and a damp fleck. Crop 1 carries a stamp in serif type reading 26525, followed by a sixth character struck twice and illegible. Taken as a date those five figures would give 26.5.25, but the digits are evenly spaced with no grouping and the over-struck character leaves the length of the string open, so I have not entered a date. Recording the stamp here in case a cleaner impression turns up on another copy.

crop 1, lower panel upright; pencil, one line, no number and no name. Three groups with stops between them and a stop at the end. The day is the continental 7, a top stroke and a long diagonal with a short bar across it; the month is the same diagonal without the bar, a 1. The year is a 2 with a base sweeping right and a closed narrow 0.

crop 1, lower panel upright; pencil, five figures run together with no separators, read as 24.2.22. Figures 1, 3, 4 and 5 are the same 2, drawn with a top curl and a base sweeping right. Figure 2 is the arguable one: two arms meeting at a point with a single stem running well below the baseline. I take it for a 4; a crossed 7 would give 27.2.22, but a 7 in these hands sits on the line and is cut by a bar at mid height, and this glyph has neither. Crop 2 carries a separate small ink initial with a stop, not a date.
